items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Every time you got to a session with Bernard Purdie, he goes to set up his little placards in the window, talking about “Hitmaker.”

ctx.x: Grady Tate on some, and then Bernard Purdie, definitely Bernard Purdie on . . .
He didn’t – Purdie didn’t play on Walking in Space. That was – when I say Walking in Space, wasn’t that a tune on the record?
